status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi forces are expanding border security by exploring Canadian drone technology and senior generals are inspecting army posture in Kirkuk, while a sting in Al-Anbar seized 34kg of drugs and arrested a suspect. A bomb attack targeted a government employee in Dhi Qar and an armed group warned it would respond forcefully if the US uses Iraqi airspace against Iran. A vessel caught fire off Iraq's coast, raising Gulf security concerns, and a commission released a document on Baghdad's deadly bombing of a Kurdish civilian camp in Iran. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske styrker utvider grensevakten ved å undersøke kanadisk droneteknologi, og høytstående generaler inspiserer hærenes stilling i Kirkuk, mens en operasjon i Al-Anbar beslagla 34 kg narkotika og arresterte en mistenkt. Et bombeangrep rettet seg mot en regjeringsansatt i Dhi Qar, og en væpnet gruppe varslet at den vil svare kraftig dersom USA bruker irakisk luftrom mot Iran. Et fartøy tok fyr utenfor Iraks kyst, noe som øker sikkerhetsbekymringene i Persiabukta, og en kommisjon publiserte et dokument om Bagdads dødelige bombeangrep på en kurdisk sivileleir i Iran. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
